description: Source registry for the Portugal energy-poverty pipeline. Unknown values are null; no web-based enrichment has been added.

field_notes.precedence: User-verified Data downloads.txt takes precedence over conflicting Data Sources.pdf claims. PDF claims remain unverified planning evidence only.
field_notes.verified: True only for lineage supplied in the user-verified download notes, within verification_scope. Does not verify APA citations, planned metadata, transformations or source-to-column derivations.
field_notes.citation_verified: Separate from lineage verification. PDF references are transcribed candidates, not independently verified references for downloaded versions.
field_notes.usage_status: pipeline_input = evidenced in pipeline; available_optional = catalogued but not required by current indices; planned_only = unconfirmed a priori candidate.
field_notes.rationale: Reason for choosing this source over alternatives; null where the supplied material does not document such a decision.
field_notes.evidence_ids: References to preserved source documents or repository/local-file evidence. PDF text remains explicitly unverified.
field_notes.raster_folders: Logical folder_catalog keys; mappings identify source families, not independent verification of processing.
field_notes.administrative_indicators: Current administrative column names mapped by subject; exact derivations remain outside download-lineage verification.

evidence.text: Manual inspection is referenced by the user-maintained CAOP and benchmark source records. A separate inspection log was not supplied. This entry registers that reference without independently validating those claims.
